You make a map that answers a question about this codebase, for someone semi-technical. Explore with Read, Grep and Glob, then return the map as JSON. You cannot edit anything.

## The question
"How does codemap turn a question into a checked diagram? Walk through the architecture from the question to the map on screen."

## What a good map is
- It follows what happens, in order, from where it starts (a button, a route, a job, a command) to where it ends (a table write, an email, an outside API), or to where it stops.
- 2–6 `areas` named in product language (Patients, Billing, Background jobs), not folder names.
- 4–12 boxes (`nodes`). Each is one step a person would recognize. `name`: plain English, at most 30 characters ("Patient marked enrolled", not "markConverted()").
- `kind`: entry (a way in), step, store (table, queue, cache), external (outside service), job (scheduled or background work).
- `explain` for every box: `concept` (1–2 plain sentences, no jargon), `how` (the mechanism; define any term you use), `code` (function and file names).
- Arrow `label`: 1–3 words saying how one step leads to the next ("sends request", "calls", "announces", "every night").
- When the trail stops, or something that should be connected isn't, record an `absence`: the `claim` in plain words, the two boxes it should connect (`between`), and the exact `search` that proves nothing is there (`pattern`, `regex`, optional `paths` globs), with `matches` set to the count that search returns (usually 0). Run that search yourself with Grep first.
- Code that exists but isn't reached from the start can still be boxes. Don't draw arrows that don't exist; use an absence.

## Evidence rules (a program checks every claim; anything it can't confirm is shown as unconfirmed)
- Every box and arrow cites at least one line: `file` (repo-relative), `line` (1-based), and `text` copied exactly from that line. A distinctive fragment of 10–80 characters works best.
- A box that is a function or method gets `symbol`: "<file>#<name>" (methods as Class.method, object members as obj.member, e.g. "src/db.ts#db.update").
- Arrow `kind`: `calls` when a function in the from box literally calls the function in the to box; `request` when an HTTP call in the from box hits a route handled by the to box; `imports`; `then` for anything else (events, ordering). The checker verifies calls, request and imports against the code, so use them only when literally true.
- Never cite or read secret files (.env, keys).

## Walkthrough (`tour`, written last)
- 4–7 stops in the order a newcomer should read them: what the map shows → the path → the problem, if there is one → what it means.
- Each stop: `title`, `text` (2–3 plain sentences), `focus` (ids of the areas, nodes, edges or absences it's about), optional `terms` it uses that need defining, and `ask` with 1–2 good next questions.
- Point stops only at boxes, arrows and absences you're confident in.

1	// The codemap command.
2	//   codemap "<question>"        map a question about the repo, then open the map
3	//   codemap open [<map-id>]     open saved maps
4	//   codemap check <map-id|file> re-check a saved map against the code (exit 1 if anything is unconfirmed)
5	//   codemap list                list saved maps
6	// Options: --repo <dir> (default: current directory)  --port <n> (default 4317)  --no-open  --model <id>
7	import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
8	import * as fs from 'node:fs';
9	import * as path from 'node:path';
10	import { check, initTreeSitterForChecks, parseMap } from './cli-support';
11	import { startServer } from './server';
12	import { createStore } from './store';
13	
14	type Args = { command: 'map' | 'open' | 'check' | 'list' | 'help'; rest: string[]; repo: string; port: number; open: boolean; model?: string };
15	
16	function parseArgs(argv: string[]): Args {
17	  const flags: Record<string, string | boolean> = {};
18	  const positional: string[] = [];
19	  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
20	    const a = argv[i]!;
21	    if (a === '--no-open') flags.open = false;
22	    else if (a === '-h' || a === '--help') flags.help = true;
23	    else if (a.startsWith('--')) flags[a.slice(2)] = argv[++i] ?? '';
24	    else positional.push(a);
25	  }
26	  const first = positional[0];
27	  const command = flags.help || !first ? 'help' : (['open', 'check', 'list', 'help'].includes(first) ? first : 'map') as Args['command'];
28	  return {
29	    command,
30	    rest: command === 'map' ? [positional.join(' ')] : positional.slice(1),
31	    repo: path.resolve(String(flags.repo ?? process.cwd())),
32	    port: Number(flags.port ?? 4317),
33	    open: flags.open !== false,
34	    model: typeof flags.model === 'string' ? flags.model : undefined,
35	  };
36	}
37	
38	function openBrowser(url: string) {
39	  const [cmd, args] = process.platform === 'darwin' ? ['open', [url]] : process.platform === 'win32' ? ['cmd', ['/c', 'start', '', url]] : ['xdg-open', [url]];
40	  spawn(cmd as string, args as string[], { stdio: 'ignore', detached: true }).unref();
41	}
42	
43	const HELP = `codemap: ask how your code works, get a map you can point at.
44	
45	  codemap "<question>"          map a question about this repo and open it
46	  codemap open [<map-id>]       open saved maps
47	  codemap check <map-id|file>   re-check a saved map against the code
48	  codemap list                  list saved maps
49	
50	Options: --repo <dir>  --port <n>  --no-open  --model <id>
51	Needs Claude: an Anthropic API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or a logged-in Claude Code.`;
52	
53	async function main() {
54	  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
55	  if (args.command === 'help') return console.log(HELP);
56	  if (!fs.existsSync(args.repo)) throw new Error(`No such folder: ${args.repo}`);
57	
58	  if (args.command === 'list') {
59	    const maps = createStore(args.repo).list();
60	    if (!maps.length) return console.log('No maps yet. Try: codemap "what happens when …?"');
61	    for (const m of maps) console.log(`${m.id}  ${m.question}`);
62	    return;
63	  }
64	
65	  if (args.command === 'check') {
66	    const target = args.rest[0];
67	    if (!target) throw new Error('Which map? codemap check <map-id|file>');
68	    await initTreeSitterForChecks();
69	    const raw = fs.existsSync(target) ? (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8')) as { map?: unknown }) : createStore(args.repo).get(target);
70	    if (!raw) throw new Error(`No map "${target}" in ${args.repo}/.codemap/maps`);
71	    const parsed = parseMap('map' in raw ? raw.map : raw);
72	    if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(`The map isn't valid:\n${parsed.problems.join('\n')}`);
73	    const report = check(parsed.map, args.repo);
74	    console.log(`${report.summary.confirmed} of ${report.summary.claims} claims confirmed`);
75	    for (const [kind, group] of [['box', report.nodes], ['arrow', report.edges], ['missing connection', report.absences]] as const) {
76	      for (const [id, c] of Object.entries(group)) if (c.status !== 'confirmed') console.log(`  ✗ ${kind} ${id}: ${c.reasons.join('; ')}`);
77	    }
78	    process.exitCode = report.summary.unconfirmed ? 1 : 0;
79	    return;
80	  }
81	
82	  const server = await startServer({ root: args.repo, port: args.port, model: args.model });
83	  let url: string;
84	  if (args.command === 'map') {
85	    const id = server.startMap(args.rest[0] ?? '');
86	    url = server.pageUrl(id);
87	    console.log(`Mapping "${args.rest[0]}" in ${args.repo}`);
88	  } else {
89	    url = server.pageUrl(args.rest[0]);
90	  }
91	  console.log(`\n  ${url}\n\nOpen that link to see the map. Press Ctrl+C to stop.`);
92	  if (args.open) openBrowser(url);
93	  const stop = () => void server.close().then(() => process.exit(0));
94	  process.on('SIGINT', stop);
95	  process.on('SIGTERM', stop);
96	}
97	
98	main().catch((err: unknown) => {
99	  console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
100	  process.exit(1);

1	// Making a map: a head start from the code facts, Claude explores and drafts, the checker re-reads the code, and Claude
2	// gets up to `repairs` chances to fix what didn't check out. The best attempt wins; nothing unconfirmed is hidden.
3	import { check, parseMap, type CheckReport, type CodeMap } from '@codemap/core';
4	import type { Agent, Progress } from './agent';
5	import { headStart } from './hints';
6	import { evidenceRepairPrompt, makerPrompt, shapeRepairPrompt } from './prompts';
7	import { MAP_SCHEMA } from './schemas';
8	
9	export type Status = { kind: 'status'; text: string };
10	export type MakeOptions = {
11	  root: string;
12	  question: string;
13	  agent: Agent;
14	  model?: string;
15	  repairs?: number;
16	  onProgress?: (p: Progress | Status) => void;
17	  signal?: AbortSignal;
18	};
19	export type MakeResult = { map: CodeMap; report: CheckReport; sessionId: string | null; cost: number; rounds: number };
20	
21	const withQuestion = (output: unknown, question: string) =>
22	  output && typeof output === 'object' ? { ...(output as Record<string, unknown>), version: 1, question } : output;
23	
24	export async function makeMap(o: MakeOptions): Promise<MakeResult> {
25	  const status = (text: string) => o.onProgress?.({ kind: 'status', text });
26	  status('Scanning the code for ways in, routes and tables');
27	  const hints = await headStart(o.root);
28	  status('Claude is exploring the code');
29	  const run = (prompt: string, resume: string | null) =>
30	    o.agent({ prompt, schema: MAP_SCHEMA, cwd: o.root, resume, model: o.model, onProgress: o.onProgress, signal: o.signal });
31	
32	  let res = await run(makerPrompt(o.question, hints.text), null);
33	  let cost = res.cost ?? 0;
34	  let rounds = 1;
35	  let best: { map: CodeMap; report: CheckReport } | null = null;
36	  let lastProblems: string[] = [];
37	
38	  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
39	    const parsed = parseMap(withQuestion(res.output, o.question));
40	    let repair: string | null = null;
41	    if (!parsed.ok) {
42	      lastProblems = parsed.problems;
43	      repair = shapeRepairPrompt(parsed.problems);
44	    } else {
45	      status('Checking every claim against the code');
46	      const report = check(parsed.map, o.root);
47	      if (!best || report.summary.unconfirmed < best.report.summary.unconfirmed) best = { map: parsed.map, report };
48	      status(`${report.summary.confirmed} of ${report.summary.claims} claims confirmed`);
49	      if (report.summary.unconfirmed > 0) repair = evidenceRepairPrompt(report);
50	    }
51	    if (!repair || attempt >= (o.repairs ?? 2)) break;
52	    status(parsed.ok ? 'Asking Claude to fix the claims that didn\'t check out' : 'Asking Claude to fix the map\'s structure');
53	    res = await run(repair, res.sessionId);
54	    cost += res.cost ?? 0;
55	    rounds++;
56	  }
57	  if (!best) throw new Error(`Claude's map couldn't be read: ${lastProblems.slice(0, 5).join('; ')}`);
58	  return { ...best, sessionId: res.sessionId, cost, rounds };
59	}

1	// The explorer's head start: what a quick deterministic scan already knows (ways in, routes, which requests hit which
2	// routes, which tables are written), so Claude spends its reading on the question instead of on finding the edges.
3	import * as fs from 'node:fs';
4	import { findFetchSites, initTreeSitter, matchRoute, scanRepoFacts, type RepoScan } from '@codemap/facts';
5	
6	const MAX_LINES = 40;
7	const section = (title: string, lines: string[]) =>
8	  lines.length ? [`${title}:`, ...lines.slice(0, MAX_LINES), ...(lines.length > MAX_LINES ? [`  …and ${lines.length - MAX_LINES} more`] : []), ''] : [];
9	
10	export async function headStart(root: string): Promise<{ text: string; scan: RepoScan | null }> {
11	  await initTreeSitter();
12	  let scan: RepoScan;
13	  try {
14	    scan = scanRepoFacts(root);
15	  } catch {
16	    return { text: '(The automatic scan could not read this repo; explore it directly.)', scan: null };
17	  }
18	  const facts = Object.values(scan.fileFacts);
19	
20	  const entries = facts.flatMap((f) => f.entries).map((e) => `  - ${e.kind} ${e.label}${e.symbol ? ` → ${e.symbol}` : ` (${e.file})`}`);
21	  const routes = facts.flatMap((f) => f.routes);
22	  const routeLines = routes.map((r) => `  - ${r.method} ${r.path} → ${r.handler ?? r.file}`);
23	
24	  const fetchFiles = facts
25	    .filter((f) => /\.(tsx?|jsx?|mjs|cjs)$/.test(f.path))
26	    .flatMap((f) => {
27	      const source = fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${f.path}`, 'utf8');
28	      return /\bfetch\(|axios|ky\./.test(source) ? [{ path: f.path, source, symbols: f.symbols }] : [];
29	    });
30	  const requests = findFetchSites(fetchFiles).flatMap((site) => {
31	    const m = matchRoute(site, routes);
32	    return m ? [`  - ${site.from} sends ${site.method} ${site.url} → ${m.route.handler ?? m.route.file}`] : [];
33	  });
34	
35	  const writers = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
36	  for (const f of facts) for (const w of f.writes) writers.set(w.table, (writers.get(w.table) ?? new Set()).add(w.symbol ?? f.path));
37	  const tables = [...writers].map(([t, by]) => `  - ${t} ← ${[...by].slice(0, 4).join(', ')}`);
38	
39	  const folders = new Map<string, number>();
40	  for (const f of scan.files) {
41	    const top = f.includes('/') ? f.slice(0, f.indexOf('/')) : '(root)';
42	    folders.set(top, (folders.get(top) ?? 0) + 1);
43	  }
44	  const folderLines = [...folders].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([d, n]) => `  - ${d}/ (${n} files)`);
45	
46	  const text = [
47	    ...section('Ways in (entry points)', entries),
48	    ...section('Routes and their handlers', routeLines),
49	    ...section('Requests from the code that match a route', requests),
50	    ...section('Tables and what writes them', tables),
51	    ...section('Top-level folders', folderLines),
52	  ].join('\n');
53	  return { text: text || '(The automatic scan found no entry points; explore the repo directly.)', scan };
54	}

1	// Maps on disk, in the target repo: `.codemap/maps/<id>.json`. Commit them to share; teammates re-check them against
2	// their own copy of the code when they open them.
3	import * as fs from 'node:fs';
4	import * as path from 'node:path';
5	import { parseMap, slugify, type CodeMap } from '@codemap/core';
6	
7	export type MapMeta = {
8	  id: string;
9	  question: string;
10	  createdAt: string;
11	  updatedAt: string;
12	  commit: string | null;
13	  makerSession: string | null;
14	  explainerSession: string | null;
15	  cost: number;
16	};
17	export type StoredMap = { meta: MapMeta; map: CodeMap };
18	
19	const ID = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,80}$/;
20	
21	export function createStore(root: string) {
22	  const base = path.join(root, '.codemap');
23	  const dir = path.join(base, 'maps');
24	
25	  const ensure = () => {
26	    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
27	    const ignore = path.join(base, '.gitignore');
28	    // Maps are worth committing; scratch output is not.
29	    if (!fs.existsSync(ignore)) fs.writeFileSync(ignore, 'fixes/\nws-modules/\n');
30	  };
31	  const file = (id: string) => {
32	    if (!ID.test(id)) throw new Error(`Not a map id: ${id}`);
33	    return path.join(dir, `${id}.json`);
34	  };
35	
36	  return {
37	    dir,
38	    get(id: string): StoredMap | null {
39	      let raw: { meta?: MapMeta; map?: unknown };
40	      try {
41	        raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file(id), 'utf8'));
42	      } catch {
43	        return null;
44	      }
45	      const parsed = parseMap(raw.map);
46	      return parsed.ok && raw.meta ? { meta: raw.meta, map: parsed.map } : null;
47	    },
48	    save(stored: StoredMap): void {
49	      ensure();
50	      const target = file(stored.meta.id);
51	      const tmp = `${target}.tmp`;
52	      fs.writeFileSync(tmp, `${JSON.stringify(stored, null, 2)}\n`);
53	      fs.renameSync(tmp, target);
54	    },
55	    list(): MapMeta[] {
56	      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
57	      return fs
58	        .readdirSync(dir)
59	        .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json'))
60	        .flatMap((f) => {
61	          try {
62	            const meta = (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf8')) as { meta?: MapMeta }).meta;
63	            return meta ? [meta] : [];
64	          } catch {
65	            return [];
66	          }
67	        })
68	        .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt));
69	    },
70	    /** A new id for a question, unique among saved maps and ids already handed out. */
71	    newId(question: string, taken: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): string {
72	      const base = slugify(question);
73	      for (let i = 1; ; i++) {
74	        const id = i === 1 ? base : `${base}-${i}`;
75	        if (!taken.has(id) && !fs.existsSync(file(id))) return id;
76	      }
77	    },
78	  };
79	}
80	
81	export type Store = ReturnType<typeof createStore>;

62	  const open = () => {

64	    ws.onopen = () => onStatus(true);

67	        onEvent(JSON.parse(String(m.data)) as ServerEvent);

69	        /* ignore malformed frames */
